text.p: Massimo da Milano Inc said Wednesday it plans to emerge from Chapter 11 bankruptcy within 60 days, and should turn a profit for 1997.

As part of its reorganization plan, Massimo's closed its unprofitable locations and as a result is expecting a profit for 1997. It also has paid in excess of $150,000 of its $350,000 debt owed to the Internal Revenue Service, and has paid $125,000 owed to the state of Texas for unpaid taxes.
Massimo said it also has brought in new restaurant management and has entered into agreements with two large bakery customers which should substantially increase revenues.
Prior to its bankruptcy filing, the company had losses in excess of $1 million. In a statement, the company attributed those losses to "an overly aggressive expansion program and mismanagement."
